description.en: Evaluates multi-agent collaboration in Minecraft-based tasks with time-sensitive complementary collaboration, requiring agent heterogeneity, mandatory collaboration, and dynamic environments. The framework generates diverse tasks via YAML specifications and filters invalid configurations.
